# File size: a source file has at most 600 lines. Tests and generated files
# do not count. `bun scripts/check-budgets.ts` checks it.
# Each line is a file over the limit: its path, and its lines (`wc -l`) on the
# day it was listed. The check fails when the file has more lines than that.
# To get off the list: split the file by sub-domain. When it has 600 lines or
# fewer, remove its line: the check fails a listed file that is within the
# limit. Add no line here.
# `bun scripts/check-budgets.ts --tighten` lowers the numbers to today's.
